title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is Grothendieck's p. 497. The previous page is 497-style numbered 397 and the next is 498. It closes a construction of auxiliary affine group schemes over a base (ultimately Ẑ or Z) used to receive a canonical homomorphism from the automorphism group M_{0,3}^{!~}. That group appears to be a group of automorphisms of the profinite fundamental group π̂_{0,3} (the thrice-punctured line), in the 'équation des lacets' / proto-Grothendieck–Teichmüller setting. The homomorphism (45) itself is stated on the next page.

Structure on this page:
(1) Dimension count. S̃M_{ρ,σ} is a flat group scheme of relative dimension 2+2+2+4 = 10. The contributions are B'_0 (2), T_ρ (2), N'_σ (2) and G (4, presumably GL_2). Here S̃M = L_0\G*_{ρ,σ}·G, built on the previous page from the semi-direct product with G*_{ρ,σ} acting on G through the factor B'_0, modulo the antidiagonal copy i(L_0) = {i_B(λ) i_G(λ^{-1})}. SM_{ρ,σ} has relative dimension 4+3 = 7, from SG*_{ρ,σ} (4) and SG (3, presumably SL_2).
(2) Quotient by i(L_0) ≅ G_m. The previous page checks that i(L_0) is normalised, indeed central, since i(λ) acts trivially on G. Dividing out gives M̃_{ρ,σ} and M_{ρ,σ}, of relative dimensions 9 and 6. These fit into the morphism of central extensions (43): 1→G_m→SM_{ρ,σ}→M_{ρ,σ}→1 mapping to 1→G_m→S̃M_{ρ,σ}→M̃_{ρ,σ}→1, with the identity on G_m and λ↦i_0(λ).
(3) Representability. The quotients cause no difficulty: they are represented as semi-direct products (44), M_{ρ,σ} ≅ SG**_{ρ,σ}(0)·SG and M̃_{ρ,σ} ≅ G**_{ρ,σ}(0)·G.
- G**_{ρ,σ}(0) ≅ T_0×T_ρ×N'_σ, of dimension 1+2+2 = 5, so 5+4 = 9. This is a complement to L_0 inside B'_0×T_ρ×N'_σ, since B'_0 ≅ L_0·T_0.
- SG**_{ρ,σ}(0) is its intersection with SG*_{ρ,σ} (conditions (20), p. 487'), of dimension 3, so 3+3 = 6.

The point is to cut a central G_m out of the 'big' group by choosing a normalisation (subscript (0)), turning a quotient into an explicit semi-direct product. The next page does the same at the profinite level: normalised automorphisms Norm(L_0), and M ≅ M(0)·π̂_{0,3}.
errors: No mathematical error found. The dimensions are internally consistent: 10−1 = 9 = 5+4 and 7−1 = 6 = 3+3.
The cited sub-groups are written SG*(0)/G*(0) in (44) but SG**(0)/G**(0) in the following text. This is a notational inconsistency in the manuscript.

ideas.what: A central G_m (antidiagonal image of L_0) is divided out of a semi-direct product of tori/Borel-type groups with GL_2 (resp. SL_2). The quotient is realised as an explicit semi-direct product by choosing a normalised complement.
ideas.modern_name: Quotient of a group scheme by a central torus; splitting via a complement (semi-direct product decomposition)
ideas.where_published: general techniques in SGA 3; this specific group not published

ideas.what: Algebraic group-scheme 'envelopes' M_{ρ,σ}, M̃_{ρ,σ} built from GL_2/SL_2 and tori attached to the local monodromies ρ, σ. They serve as targets for a homomorphism from the automorphism group of π̂_{0,3} (next page: into M_{ρ,σ}(Ẑ)/Σ).
ideas.modern_name: Linear (SL_2/GL_2-type) representations of GT-like automorphism groups of π̂_1(P^1−{0,1,∞})
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ihara, Nakamura, Drinfeld and others for related GT representations (1980s–90s)
ideas.where_published: Not in Esquisse or the published Longue Marche excerpts as far as known; unsure

missed.claim: Grothendieck sets up explicit finite-dimensional group schemes, of relative dimensions 9 and 6, as algebraic hulls receiving automorphisms of π̂_{0,3} modulo a sign group Σ ≅ {±1}^3. This is a concrete algebraic-group target for a GT-type group. On this page it is only construction and bookkeeping.
missed.quote: en passant aux quotients par i(L_0) ≃ G_m on obtient des groupes M̃_{ρ,σ}, M_{ρ,σ}, plats ... de dim relative 9 resp. 6
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This could be compared with known SL_2(Ẑ)-type representations of GT and of the absolute Galois group. Its value depends on the following pages.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is routine bookkeeping: dimension counts and representability of quotients by a central G_m via semi-direct products. Its interest lies in the surrounding unpublished programme, not in this page itself.
transcription_corrections: 'on obtient des groupes M_{ρ,σ}, M_{ρ,σ}' should read 'des groupes M̃_{ρ,σ}, M_{ρ,σ}', with dimensions 9 resp. 6.
'se fait par des difficultés' is likely 'se fait sans difficultés'.
In (44) the first left-hand side is M_{ρ,σ}, with an 'S' crossed out, and the second is M̃_{ρ,σ}. The right-hand sides carry ** superscripts: SG**_{ρ,σ}(0)·SG and G**_{ρ,σ}(0)·G.
The page number printed '392' is the archive page; Grothendieck's own numbering is presumably 497.
